headline: On last trading day, September 17, Nifty and Sensex ended mixed amid Fed hike concerns and NSE IPO.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

Volatility in crude oil prices and FII selling pressure impacted domestic indices

summary: On the last trading day, Indian indices ended mixed as the market grappled with Fed rate hike fears and geopolitical tensions. Key stocks like Paytm and dividend-paying firms remained in focus while crude oil volatility influenced sentiment. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, September 21.
